heroCopy.description: From focused SaaS products to custom enterprise platforms, Mossaic builds software for Indian businesses — starting with healthcare and extending into retail and complex enterprise needs.

productsCopy.description: Specialized vertical SaaS alongside custom-engineered platforms for businesses with more complex needs.

mission.body: Build modular, compliant, India-first SaaS for day-to-day operations, alongside custom enterprise web platforms for complex business needs. We keep both product and engineering work grounded in how Indian businesses actually operate — without forcing them to learn the software, hire a consultant, or hand their data to a foreign cloud.

vision.body: A future where the dental clinic, the kirana store and the diagnostic lab all run on tools designed for them — not retrofitted from Silicon Valley. Modular, explainable and priced for the market they actually live in.

company.focus: Vertical SaaS · Healthcare · Retail · AI · Enterprise platforms

principles.title: Modular by default
principles.desc: Every feature is a module. Customers add what they need, skip what they don't. No feature bloat, no forced upgrades, no all-or-nothing contracts.

principles.title: Compliance built in
principles.desc: DISHA, IT Act, and industry-specific data regulations are not afterthoughts. Audit trails, consent management, and data locality are part of the foundation.

principles.title: Explainable, not opaque
principles.desc: Where AI is used — in imaging, in scheduling, in recommendations — we show our working. Grad-CAM overlays, confidence scores, and audit trails come standard.

principles.title: India-first architecture
principles.desc: Data hosted in India-region servers. Pricing in rupees. GST-ready billing. Built for Indian regulatory reality, not retrofitted from Western markets.
